t: A prayer about anyone placed in authority
a: اللَّهُمَّ مَنْ وَلِيَ مِنْ أَمْرِ أُمَّتِي شَيْئًا فَشَقَّ عَلَيْهِمْ فَاشْقُقْ عَلَيْهِ وَمَنْ وَلِيَ مِنْ أَمْرِ أُمَّتِي شَيْئًا فَرَفَقَ بِهِمْ فَارْفُقْ بِهِ
p: Allāhumma man waliya min amri ummatī shay'an fa-shaqqa ʿalayhim fa-shquq ʿalayh, wa man rafaqa bihim fa-rfuq bih.
m: O Allah, whoever takes charge of any affair of my nation and is hard on them, be hard on him. And whoever is gentle with them, be gentle with him.
